channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US aviation sanctions disrupt Iran flights, push travellers overland
item.description: Travel disruptions intensify as Iranian airlines lose access to airspace, pushing civilians towards costly land routes.

item.title: Gaza flotilla activist on hunger strike in Tunisia jail ‘on verge of death’
item.description: Wael Naouar has been hospitalised as his hunger strike enters its 39th day, the Gaza Sumud Flotilla says.

item.title: Iran threatens countries enforcing US airline sanctions
item.description: Iran has threatened countries enforcing US sanctions on its airlines, warning that their airports could face disruptions

item.title: Iran’s Pezeshkian slams ‘terrorist’ US but extols diplomacy in UN speech
item.description: Pezeshkian leaves door open for negotiations, while calling out US blockade against Iran in Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
item.description: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

item.title: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
item.description: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.

item.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
item.description: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.
